Name: Abdullah Hasan
Tem Author Single Details: With deep roots in the traditional Pinisi shipbuilding heritage of Tanah Lemo, Bulukumba, I combine ancestral craftsmanship with modern maritime standards. As a co-founder of Bina Pusaka (BP Marine Co), I lead the development of wooden vessels that honor cultural legacy while meeting contemporary operational demands. My focus is on quality, precision, and sustaining the generations-old knowledge embedded in every Pinisi we build.
